title: Figure 2: Operation of an Ultracapacitor (electrical double layer schematic)
description: Cross-section schematic showing two 'Activated carbon electrodes' separated by an 'Electrolyte' with a 'Separator soaked in electrolyte', and rows of plus and minus charges forming double layers at each interface. A side panel titled 'Material selection and construction' lists electrodes, separator, electrolyte, wound component and case. The caption explains a simple ultracapacitor uses two similar electrodes (typically carbon) with a separator and electrolyte.
